title: LUBARCHY normalized hardware inventory v1
description: Observation only: normalized facts read from Linux (sysfs, udev, kernel). Contains no policy, no package names, no wall-clock time and no privacy-sensitive identifiers. Undeclared fields are rejected at every level; new facts require a new schema version.

devices.description: Observed PCI and USB devices. Canonical order: ascending by id (Unicode code point order).

snapshotId.description: Snapshot-local device identifier: '<bus>:<locator>'. Unique within one inventory only; it is a topology position, not a stable hardware identity across boots or machines, and is never used for compatibility matching.

driver.description: Name of the kernel driver bound to the device or interface, when one is bound.

modules.description: Kernel module names associated with the bound driver, with '-' normalized to '_'. Canonical order: ascending, unique.

system.description: Platform facts of the running system.

architecture.description: Debian architecture of the running system (as dpkg reports it).

boot_firmware.description: Firmware interface the system booted through. Absent when not determined.

secure_boot.description: Observed Secure Boot state. 'unknown' when it could not be read; observation only, never a policy.

virtualization.description: Virtualization observation. Absent when not determined.

kind.description: 'none' for bare metal, 'vm' for a virtual machine, 'container' for a container.

technology.description: Virtualization technology identifier (systemd-detect-virt vocabulary, e.g. 'kvm', 'qemu'). Only present for 'vm' or 'container'.

cpu.description: Processor facts (from /proc/cpuinfo and sysfs). Microcode requirements are policy and never appear here.

architecture.description: Processor instruction set architecture (kernel machine name).

vendor.description: CPUID vendor identification string with surrounding whitespace removed, e.g. 'GenuineIntel', 'AuthenticAMD'.

family.description: CPU family as a decimal integer.

model.description: CPU model as a decimal integer.

stepping.description: CPU stepping as a decimal integer, where available.

model_name.description: Human-readable model name. Informational only; never used for matching.

microcode_revision.description: Observed microcode revision: '0x' followed by lowercase hexadecimal without leading zeros.

id.description: Snapshot-local id: 'pci:' followed by the locator.

parent.description: Snapshot id of the parent device (e.g. the PCI bridge), when it is part of this inventory.

locator.description: PCI domain:bus:device.function. Snapshot-local; must equal the id without its 'pci:' prefix.

subsystem_vendor_id.description: Absent when the kernel does not provide it; never invented as zero.

subsystem_device_id.description: Absent when the kernel does not provide it; never invented as zero.

class_id.description: PCI class code: base class, subclass, programming interface.

modalias.description: Kernel modalias, preserved byte-for-byte as the kernel provides it (uppercase hexadecimal, as kernel module aliases use).

usbDevice.description: A USB device (not a root hub; root hubs are represented by their PCI host controller).

id.description: Snapshot-local id: 'usb:' followed by the locator.

parent.description: Snapshot id of the parent device (host controller or hub), when it is part of this inventory.

locator.description: USB topology locator '<bus>-<port>[.<port>...]'. Snapshot-local; must equal the id without its 'usb:' prefix.

interfaces.description: Interfaces of the active configuration. Canonical order: ascending by number, unique numbers.

modalias.description: Kernel interface modalias, preserved byte-for-byte as the kernel provides it.
